name: EA_OBJPROP_CHART_ID
summary: This EA is a utility that demonstrates how to create and manage OBJ_CHART objects (embedded charts) within an indicator subwindow. It displays a daily (D1) and H4 chart inside a custom subwindow indicator, each with its own Price Channel indicator attached. The EA does not open any trades; it purely showcases chart object manipulation and multi-timeframe chart embedding.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个工具类程序，演示如何在指标子窗口中创建和管理OBJ_CHART对象（嵌入式图表）。它在一个自定义子窗口指标内显示日线(D1)和H4周期图表，并各自附加了Price Channel指标。该EA不进行任何交易，纯粹展示图表对象操作和多周期图表嵌入功能。
strategy_analysis: 该EA并非交易策略，而是一个MQL5图形对象操作工具。其核心功能是利用OBJ_CHART对象在指标子窗口中嵌入不同时间周期的图表，实现多周期同屏显示。入场条件不适用，因为该EA不执行任何交易操作。出场条件同样不适用。仓位管理不涉及，因为没有开仓行为。资金管理也不存在。EA的主要技术点包括：通过ObjectCreate创建OBJ_CHART对象，使用ObjectSetInteger设置图表属性（位置、大小、缩放、时间周期），通过OBJPROP_CHART_ID获取嵌入图表的句柄，再使用ChartSetInteger/ChartSetDouble对该嵌入图表进行进一步配置（背景色、前景、网格、偏移等），最后通过iCustom和ChartIndicatorAdd为嵌入图表添加Price Channel指标。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy but rather an MQL5 graphical object manipulation utility. Its core function is to embed charts of different timeframes within an indicator subwindow using OBJ_CHART objects, enabling multi-timeframe simultaneous display on a single screen. Entry conditions are not applicable since this EA does not execute any trading operations. Exit conditions are similarly not applicable. Position sizing is not involved as there are no opening positions. Money management does not exist either. The main technical points of the EA include: creating OBJ_CHART objects via ObjectCreate, setting chart properties (position, size, scale, timeframe) using ObjectSetInteger, obtaining the embedded chart handle through OBJPROP_CHART_ID, further configuring the embedded chart (background color, foreground, grid, shift) using ChartSetInteger/ChartSetDouble, and finally adding the Price Channel indicator to the embedded charts via iCustom and ChartIndicatorAdd.

parameters.name: daily_chart
parameters.description: 日线图表ID变量，用于存储D1嵌入图表的句柄

parameters.name: H4_chart
parameters.description: H4图表ID变量，用于存储H4嵌入图表的句柄

pros: 演示了OBJ_CHART对象的完整创建和配置流程，对MQL5图形编程学习非常有价值
实现了多周期图表同屏显示功能，方便交易者同时监控不同时间周期的市场动态
代码结构清晰，CreateChartInSubwindow函数封装良好，参数化设计便于复用和修改
pros_en: Demonstrates the complete creation and configuration flow of OBJ_CHART objects, highly valuable for learning MQL5 graphical programming
Implements multi-timeframe chart simultaneous display, enabling traders to monitor different timeframe market dynamics on one screen
Clean code structure with well-encapsulated CreateChartInSubwindow function and parameterized design for easy reuse and modification
cons: 不执行任何交易操作，仅作为技术演示用途，实用价值有限
OnDeinit中对象删除代码被注释掉，可能导致EA卸载后图表对象残留
硬编码了指标路径和参数值，缺乏输入参数配置灵活性，无法适应不同用户需求
cons_en: Does not execute any trading operations, serving only as a technical demonstration with limited practical utility
Object deletion code in OnDeinit is commented out, potentially leaving residual chart objects after EA removal
Hardcoded indicator paths and parameter values lack input configuration flexibility, unable to adapt to different user needs
improvements: 取消注释OnDeinit中的对象删除代码，并增加完整的资源清理逻辑，防止EA卸载后遗留图形对象
将硬编码的参数（图表名称、尺寸、指标路径等）改为input参数，增强灵活性和可配置性
improvements_en: Uncomment the object deletion code in OnDeinit and add comprehensive resource cleanup logic to prevent residual graphical objects after EA removal
Convert hardcoded parameters (chart names, dimensions, indicator paths, etc.) into input parameters for enhanced flexibility and configurability

risk_points: OnDeinit中对象删除代码被注释掉，EA反复加载卸载可能导致OBJ_CHART对象堆积占用内存
依赖外部自定义指标'Subwindow'和'Price_Channel'，若这些指标不存在则初始化会部分失败
risk_points_en: Commented-out object deletion in OnDeinit may cause OBJ_CHART object accumulation and memory consumption if EA is repeatedly loaded and unloaded
Depends on external custom indicators 'Subwindow' and 'Price_Channel'; if these indicators are absent, initialization will partially fail
